## gRPC — dapi-grpc
| Keyword | Service | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|---------|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `Platform.getDocumentHistory` | Platform | ± | **Breaking at protocol 15**: the node serves the new `v1` envelope and rejects the retired `v0` request with non-retryable `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. Through protocol 14 it serves `v0`. The RPC name and the V0 schema are unchanged. | Route by network protocol version. Regenerate stubs and send V1 from protocol 15 onward. | [PR:4652] [PR:4657] [PR:6022] [PR:6043] |
| `GetDocumentHistoryRequest` | Platform | ± | Adds `GetDocumentHistoryRequestV1`. Its required `filter` is one of `start_at_ms` (inclusive), `start_after` (exclusive `Cursor{time_ms, revision}`), `start_at_revision` (inclusive), or `revision` (one retained revision). Its limit is 1–10 and defaults to 10 for a page. | Replace the V0 timestamp plus offset with a selector and then advance using the last entry's time and revision. | [PR:4652] |
| `GetDocumentHistoryResponse` | Platform | ± | Adds `GetDocumentHistoryResponseV1`. The unproved result carries `History` with revisioned `Entry{time_ms, revision, document}` and a `Lifecycle` (`ACTIVE`, `ABSENT`, `DELETED`, `ERASING`). With `prove`, one GroveDB proof authenticates the retained page and lifecycle at the signed block. | Decode the response envelope's V1 branch and check the lifecycle even when the page contains entries. | [PR:4652] [PR:4657] |
| `Platform.getDocuments` | Platform | ± | From protocol 15, document queries refuse private types. The unproved response still carries signed 64-bit sums and refuses sums beyond that range. A proved query can carry the full 128-bit sum through the GroveDB proof. | Read private types with `getPrivateDocumentEntries`. Use proved reads and a 5.1 verifier for sums outside the signed 64-bit range. | [PR:5703] [PR:6095] |
| `Platform.getRecentStateTransitionStatus` | Platform | + | PV15 adds an immediate, unproved lookup by 32-byte `state_transition_hash`. `GetRecentStateTransitionStatusResponse` reports `committed` (height and an error when execution failed), `pending`, or `unknown` from the answering node. | Use it for status display. Use verified input reads or the SDK's `state_transition_outcome` for decisions about funds. Query the original broadcast node for a shielded or private document transition. | [PR:5823] |
| `Platform.getYesNoVotePollState` | Platform | + | PV15 adds a lookup by `vote_poll_id` with `prove`. `GetYesNoVotePollStateResponse` returns the typed purpose and threshold, live tallies for a started poll and a final recorded result for a finished poll. No status means the poll has not been opened. | Derive the 32-byte poll ID from its purpose using the SDK. Read final tallies from `finished`, since the live counters are cleared at finalization. | [PR:5651] [PR:5680] |
| `Platform.getMasternodeYesNoVote` | Platform | + | PV15 adds a lookup by `pro_tx_hash` and `vote_poll_id` with `prove`. `GetMasternodeYesNoVoteResponse` returns an optional `YES`, `NO`, or `ABSTAIN` choice and `times_voted`. | Handle an absent vote for both a masternode that has never voted and votes cleared at finalization. | [PR:5651] [PR:5680] |
| `Platform.getPrivateDocumentEntries` | Platform | + | PV15 adds an encrypted store read by contract, type and zero-based `start_position`. The response contains entries up to the end of the starting storage chunk and `total_count`, or a GroveDB proof with `prove`. | Page from the last returned position plus one until reaching `total_count`. Verify the proof and open entries on the client. | [PR:5708] |
| `Platform.getOwnerTransactionsInBlock` | Platform | + | New Tenderdash-backed RPC by `height`, `owner_id` and `prove`. Returns the owner's transitions and results in block order. With proofs, each returned transition is authenticated against its block. The proved response can fail with `FAILED_PRECONDITION` above 4,000,000 bytes. | Gate new calls on protocol 15 as the SDK does. Fetch the whole block with `getBlocks` when you need completeness or the proved owner response exceeds the limit. | [PR:5815] |
| `Platform.getBlocks` | Platform | + | New Tenderdash-backed RPC for 1–10 consecutive blocks with transition results and optional signed-header proofs. A page can end early at the chain tip or response size limit. The dashmate gateway allows 30 requests per hour per IP. | Gate new calls on protocol 15 as the SDK does. For lookup pagination, resume from the last returned height plus one. | [PR:5815] |
| `TenderdashBlockProof` | Platform | + | New shared message with `Header`, `BlockId`, signing round, quorum hash/type and threshold signature. The signed header commits to the block's transactions and their results. | Use the SDK verifier or authenticate the signature and the signed block ID before accepting the contents. | [PR:5815] |
| `TenderdashTransactionProof` | Platform | + | New per-transaction proof with block index, transaction count and separate Merkle paths to the block's transaction and execution result roots. | Verify both paths against the signed header for each returned transaction. | [PR:5815] |
